restartRequired.note: the accepted worker reads the registry once at startup; a new project id needs a worker restart or a new worker-side registry API

options.name: worker-managed dynamic registry
options.description: worker owns projectsRoot + registry file, project.create copies a template into projectsRoot, validates realpath containment and persists the registry; startup reloads it
options.cost: new worker method + atomic registry write + single-writer ownership; Host never edits worker files
options.risk: two writers / stale registry must be prevented by ownership; projectId must be validated
options.verifiedBy: registry rewrite + restart experiments above; project.create itself is a proposal

options.name: Host restarts the worker after creating a project
options.description: Host creates the directory+registry entry and restarts the worker
options.risk: loses idle-warm worker, in-memory operationId cache and pending UI state; must not interrupt a render

recommendation.recommendation: worker-managed projectsRoot with persisted registry and an explicit project.create is preferred; register once at startup and avoid Host editing worker files directly
